composition_law_S011_79.law: no gain may be stacked before it has survived alone

survived_alone.win: MLP affine2_g64_ls 2.5 bpw with per-group bias

refused_for_stacking.why: PROJECTION ONLY — never packed, no runtime path, acceptance never measured (G038)
PROJECTION ONLY — no prefix cache exists, no TTFT was observed to fall (G037)
UNTESTED — G035 sanctions the probe, nobody has run it

composition_law_S011_79.consequence: the two survivors are already composed. The grand candidate is therefore variantB itself, not a new stack. Building a grander body would require stacking projections, which §79 forbids.

adversary.question: is 2.756 EBPW derived from bytes, or restated from a constant?
adversary.method: sum every payload file independently of MIX_REPORT
adversary.note: byte-exact agreement; the 3.2e-5 difference from the MIX_REPORT figure is the excluded segment headers, which is documented behaviour

adversary.question: does the candidate secretly depend on another artifact?
adversary.method: walk every file with nlink>1 and locate the other end of the link
adversary.found: 353 segments were hardlinked into ~/models/qwen38-gravity-uniform-q4-v1, the q4 incumbent. The same defect the clean rebuild had already fixed, reintroduced because composition_isolation writes variants FLAT while the de-hardlink gate assumed a nested <root>/<MIX_ID>/ layout and could not run on them.
adversary.fix: all 353 regenerated from the bf16 parent and accepted only on byte-identical comparison; 0 mismatched, 0 still shared

adversary.question: can it run without borrowing another artifact's tokenizer?
adversary.found: 0 of 7 closure files. Every capability and HCLI score for this body was obtained by pointing --tokenizer-dir at a DIFFERENT closure, so the candidate was never self-contained.
adversary.fix: closure sealed from the parent; payload and EBPW unchanged because closure files are not payload

adversary.question: does it actually run from its own closure?
adversary.method: load the tokenizer and chat template FROM THE ARTIFACT and decode

result.prompt: Name the capital of France in one word.

adversary.outcome: SURVIVED (only after A2 and A3 were fixed)

adversary.question: is the 6-point capability gap over variantB a property of the bodies, or of the harness?
adversary.method: re-score the full 43-item suite with a neutral default system prompt applied only to the 15 items that define none
adversary.finding: the gap collapses from 6 to 0. sealed FALLS 30->27 (it loses the knowledge axis outright) while variantB RISES 24->27 (coding goes 0.000 to 1.000). They tie. The capability advantage that helped justify the resident selection is an artifact of the no-system-prompt regime, and variantB is again the more prompt-robust body.
adversary.consequence: G040's Pareto input 'capability_passed' must be read as regime-conditional. The selection itself survives on the composite, which is measured under a single consistent regime, but the capability column no longer separates the two bodies.

verdict: the candidate SURVIVED as a body, but three of five attacks landed. Two were real defects in the artifact and are fixed: it depended on 353 hardlinks into the q4 incumbent and carried none of its own closure. The third is not a defect in the body but in how it was measured, and it stands: the capability gap between the two frontier bodies is a harness regime artifact, not a property of the bodies.
